title: Pi cost session snapshot
description: Payload the Pi extension POSTs to /api/ingest. Numbers and identifiers only: no prompt text, no assistant text, no tool input or output, no file contents, no credentials. The server rejects unknown keys, so a future extension version cannot quietly start shipping transcript data into the database.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. The server rejects anything it does not understand. Version 2 added the four cost components.

sessionId.description: Pi session UUID from the session header.

sessionFile.description: Absolute path to the session JSONL file.

cwd.description: Project directory from the session header.

name.description: Session display name set with /name. Capped, and optional.

parentSessionId.description: Set for a session created by /fork or /clone.

parentSessionFile.description: The path Pi wrote in the header's parentSession, named <started>_<uuid>.jsonl. The server keeps the path and the id it reads out of the name.

entryCount.description: Session entries excluding the header. Monotonic guard: an update only applies when this is not lower than what the server stored.

costMicros.description: US dollars times 1e6, rounded once per entry.

costInputMicros.description: The session's share of each bill component. The four components add up to costMicros, within a rounding allowance of two micro-dollars per event.

events.description: Complete set of usage facts for the session, not a delta. The server replaces the stored set inside one transaction, so ingest is idempotent and arrival order does not matter.

entryId.description: Session entry id, stable across reports.

provider.description: From the entry when it names one; otherwise the model in effect at that point in the session.

costInputMicros.description: What this call cost in prompt tokens.

costOutputMicros.description: What this call cost in completion tokens.

costCacheReadMicros.description: What this call cost in cached prompt tokens re-read.

costCacheWriteMicros.description: What this call cost in prompt tokens written to cache.

reportedBy.description: Which Pi event sent this snapshot.

reportedAt.description: When the extension built the snapshot.
